scenario.description: A release engineering manager must approve the production rollout plan for a critical dependency patch across the service fleet, including rollout waves, a service exception, evidence controls, and customer communication.

shared_context.S1: A critical dependency patch has passed staging tests and is ready for production rollout.
shared_context.S2: The standard change window is Saturday from 1:30 AM to 3:00 AM, with a canary followed by a fleet-wide rollout.
shared_context.S3: Maya has authority to approve the production rollout plan.
shared_context.S4: The change-control meeting routinely gives application engineering, infrastructure operations, compliance operations, and customer support a chance to review the plan before Maya approves it.
shared_context.S5: The change-control meeting routinely finalizes the rollout plan in the same meeting after each function gives its review; any follow-up tickets or checklist updates are recorded as commitments rather than reasons to defer the approval decision.

PF1.text: While testing the patch against a legacy reporting worker for a separate compatibility task this afternoon, Leon found that the patch breaks that worker's signed CSV export unless a compatibility switch is enabled; the switch will not be ready until Monday at 10:00 AM, and he has not yet filed the compatibility ticket.

PF2.text: Nia measured the production fleet during this morning's capacity exercise and confirmed that only 60 of the 84 nodes can be safely rebooted in Saturday's window; the remaining 24 nodes require a second maintenance wave on Sunday from 2:00 AM to 3:30 AM, but she has not updated the change record with the measurement.

PF3.text: During an audit-evidence review yesterday, Owen confirmed that this vulnerability's remediation record must retain a signed patch manifest for exactly 730 days; the ordinary change template does not include signed manifests or that retention period, and he has not opened the compliance follow-up.

PF4.text: Tara confirmed with the account team an hour ago that Acme's support agreement requires at least 4 hours' notice before production maintenance plus status updates at the start and end of the work; she has not added those requirements to the customer-communication checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The patch rollout must be approved.
Exactly 60 nodes must be in the first rollout wave.
Exactly 24 nodes must be in the second rollout wave.
The second rollout wave must run Sunday from 2:00 AM to 3:30 AM.
The legacy reporting worker must be exempted until Monday at 10:00 AM.
A compatibility commitment for the legacy reporting worker must be recorded.
The signed patch manifest must be retained for exactly 730 days.
A signed patch manifest must be required.
A compliance-evidence commitment must be recorded.
Acme must receive at least 4 hours' notice.
Start and end status updates for Acme must be included.
A customer-communication commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C4: decisions['first_wave_nodes'] == 60 and decisions['second_wave_nodes'] == 24 and decisions['second_wave_window'] == 'Sunday 2:00 AM to 3:30 AM'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['ticket', 'compatibility_commitment', 'compatibility_followup'] or 'legacy reporting worker' in c.get('detail', '') or 'compatibility switch' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: decisions['evidence_retention_days'] == 730 and decisions['signed_manifest_required'] == True and any(c.get('target', '') == 'Owen' and 'signed patch manifest' in c.get('detail', '') and '730' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C13: any(c['type'] in ['customer_communication', 'update-checklist', 'customer_notice'] or 'Acme notification' in c.get('detail', '') or '4-hour notice' in c.get('detail', '') or 'status updates' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The compatibility failure changes the plan from a uniform rollout to exempting the legacy reporting worker until exactly Monday at 10:00 AM and adding a compatibility commitment.
The measured reboot capacity changes the rollout from the standard single window to exactly 60 nodes first, 24 nodes second, with the second wave on Sunday from 2:00 AM to 3:30 AM.
The audit requirement changes evidence handling to a signed manifest retained for exactly 730 days and adds a compliance-evidence commitment.
Acme's support agreement changes customer handling to exactly 4 hours' notice, start-and-end status updates, and a customer-communication commitment.
